shared_elements: a plant or leafy branch motif
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on pale buff stone in an upright rectangular field, each combining profile figures with a leafy branch/plant motif and a horizontal banded division, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a finely modelled, anatomically detailed anthropomorphic winged figure holding a handled vessel beside a carefully patterned rosette-bearing plant, while B is a blocky, schematic array of animals and abstract zigzag banding with almost no interior modelling.
